title: anthemis chrysantha
intro: Anthemis chrysantha, commonly known as Golden Marguerite, is a perennial flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is known for its bright yellow flowers and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Anthemis chrysantha include reducing inflammation, relieving anxiety and insomnia, and alleviating menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, sedative, and antispasmodic properties.
